title: Build a ticket support can act on
body: A complete ticket helps support resolve the issue faster. Here is a role-based example: members of one department no longer see results from a connected wiki.

steps.title: Issue description
steps.body: Members of the finance group stopped seeing wiki pages in search. Steps: sign in as a finance user, search for a known page title.

steps.title: Error messages
steps.body: Paste the exact text or error code shown. If no error appears, say so.

steps.title: Timing
steps.body: First seen at a specific date and time, with the timezone, so support can match system logs.

steps.title: User impact
steps.body: State if one account or multiple users are affected.

steps.title: Document reference
steps.body: Add the URL of one page that should appear but does not.

steps.title: Visual evidence
steps.body: Attach a screenshot or recording of the search and its results.
